about: The steward's two keys from one 32-byte secret (#488, crypto/steward.ts, docs/spec/listed-doors.md §6.2): the Ed25519 key that signs notices is the RFC 8032 key of HKDF-SHA-256(secret, salt empty, info reconcile/v1/steward-sign, 32 bytes), and the X25519 key reports are sealed to is the RFC 7748 key of the same under reconcile/v1/steward-box. Computed with Python's cryptography package (OpenSSL) by scripts/steward_key.py, none of it @noble. The secret is SHA-256 of reconcile/vector/steward. Each secret and public key is its bytes; the labels are text.
